title: Stata command and package family registry
scope: Common official Stata command families and widely used community packages. This is a retrieval and coverage index, not an endorsement of every command use or a dependency installer.

global_template_policy.selection_rule: Add a command index entry and a small state-compatible atomic template; do not add estimator-specific detector branches merely because a new estimator appears.
quarantine: manual result transfer into final tables

families.notes: Use declared file paths and schema contracts; sysuse and a plain declared use/save are harmless primitives.

New persistent variables require nearby meaning and label evidence.
Panel-key declaration and model specification remain separate transitions.
Plain summarize/tabstat is direct; grouped materialization and shared summary data are atomic templates.
